r: Site **discovered** by **A.R. Saraswati** (A. Rangaswami Sarasvati, Telugu Assistant, Madras epigraphy office) – discoverer of Nagarjunakonda (Nagarjuna Hill)
Large **rescue excavation** before submergence (the **1950s** dig), led by **R. Subrahmanyam**; palace complex and brick Brahmanical temples
ASI dismantled and rebuilt monuments on higher ground at **Anupu** (Krishna bank) and on **Nagarjunakonda island** – "**transplanted monuments**"; India's only **island museum**
Court language and language of the Ikshvaku inscriptions, including the Nagarjunakonda records of gifts to the great monastery
Brought **Sanskrit** into inscriptions; Sanskrit replaced Prakrit from the **4th c. CE**
**Swarna Devalayam** (Golden Temple), Nagarjunakonda, Ehuvala's **11th** regnal year
**First Sanskrit inscription** of Andhra and South India

r: **Wheel-shaped (spoked) plan** + **ayaka platforms** in the four directions, **five pillars** each – ayaka platforms belong to **Buddhist stupas**
Follow the **Agamic** plan: garbhagudi, antarala, mantapa, dhvajastambha, prakara; the Ikshvakus laid the base of **Dravida** temple architecture
Sports arena, thought built with **Roman help**; no parallel elsewhere in India
Built on rules of sound; the site's most unique find
Town credited to commander **Elisri**, who also built the Sarvadevalaya; in **Nalgonda** district (now Telangana), across the Krishna from Nagarjunakonda
**Main centre** of the **Amaravati School** in its **final, most mature phase**; **Mahayana** themes – Buddha's life and **Jataka** stories
The "**last flicker**" of the Satavahana Amaravati tradition
Most important Ikshvaku sculpture; first depiction of a Chakravarti
First depiction of **sati** in Indian art
Start of the "**Sculptor's Style**" – e.g. **Badantacharya** at the Mahavihara

3.x: **Largest stupa in AP** = **Amaravati**; oldest stupa in Andhra = **Bhattiprolu**.

r: **Udyotana** – records foreign students at **Dhanyakataka and Nagarjunakonda**
